product_information.title: Indication
product_information.value:
Treatment of prolonged, acute, convulsive seizures in infants from 3 months to adults.

BUCCOLAM must only be used by parents/carers where the patient has been diagnosed to have epilepsy.
For infants between 3-6 months of age treatment should be in a hospital setting where monitoring is possible and resuscitation equipment is available.
